headline: IRM Energy Limited: Shareholders meeting
sum: Shareholders meeting — IRM Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Court Convened General Meeting of Equity Shareholders to be held on September 12, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. as per the Order of NCLT Ahmedabad
